description: This literature information source compares anaerobic volatile-fatty-acid production across 178 experimental cases, comprising 156 laboratory and 22 pilot studies. The abstract names industrial sludge or waste, municipal organic or food waste, municipal wastewater or sludge, and mixed streams. It discusses pH, temperature, retention time and organic loading in relation to yields, giving a concrete treatment-process parameter and comparison role. The native deposit lists a manuscript PDF; no standalone data file or complete machine-readable compilation is established. Experimental independence, harmonized units, geographic coverage and case-level uncertainties remain unknown, so the reported case count is not a validated dataset-row count. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
